title: Markdown Sample
description: An introduction to how to use Markdown syntax.
content_md:
## Headings Markdown ``` # Heading 1 ## Heading 2 ### Heading 3 #### Heading 4 ##### Heading 5 ###### Heading 6 ``` Rendered # Heading 1 ## Heading 2 ### Heading 3 #### Heading 4 ##### Heading 5 ###### Heading 6 --- ## Text decoration Markdown ``` **Bold (asterisks)** *Italic (asterisks)* ~~Strikethrough~~ `inline code` **Bold with *italic* combined** ``` Rendered **Bold (asterisks)** *Italic (asterisks)* ~~Strikethrough~~ `inline code` **Bold with *italic* combined** --- ## Lists Markdown ``` ### Bulleted list (hyphen) - Item A - Item B - Item C ### Bulleted list (asterisk) * Item 1 * Item 2 ### Numbered list 1. First 2. Second 3. Third ``` Rendered ### Bulleted list (hyphen) - Item A - Item B - Item C ### Bulleted list (asterisk) * Item 1 * Item 2 ### Numbered list 1. First 2. Second 3. Third --- ## Blockquotes Markdown ``` > This is a blockquote. ``` Rendered > This is a blockquote. --- ## Code blocks See the page editor screen for the raw markdown. Rendered ``` function hello() { echo 'Hello, mikanBox!'; } ``` --- ## Links Markdown → HTML ``` [Go to top page](index)　→　Go to top page [External link](https://example.com)　→　External link ``` Rendered [Go to top page](index) [External link](https://example.com) --- ## Images Markdown → HTML ``` ![Image description](mikanBox.jpg)　→　 ``` The image path is resolved automatically by the system. --- ## Spacing between markdown symbols and content There must be a half-width or full-width space between a markdown symbol and its content. Markdown ``` ### Heading after a half-width space - Bulleted item with a half-width space 1. Numbered item with a half-width space ###　Heading after a full-width space -　Bulleted item with a full-width space 1.　Numbered item with a full-width space ###Heading with no space -Bulleted item with no space 1.Numbered item with no space ``` Rendered ### Heading after a half-width space - Bulleted item with a half-width space 1. Numbered item with a half-width space ###　Heading after a full-width space -　Bulleted item with a full-width space 1.　Numbered item with a full-width space ###Heading with no space (Markdown does not activate) -Bulleted item with no space (Markdown does not activate) 1.Numbered item with no space (Markdown does not activate) --- ## Tables Markdown ``` | Left | Center | Right | Unspecified | |:-------|:----:|-------:|-| | A | B | C | D | ``` A second row is required — the row above it becomes the header row. The "-" needs at least one per column. Rendered | Left | Center | Right | Unspecified | |:-------|:----:|-------:|-| | A | B | C | D | --- ## Custom attributes `{.class #id}` — a mikanBox-specific feature ### Block elements (headings, paragraphs, etc.) Writing `{.className}` / `{#idName}` at the end of a line adds a class/id to that line's block element. Important: write it at the end of the same line as the target text. For a paragraph spanning multiple lines, put it at the end of the last line to apply it to the whole paragraph. Markdown → HTML ``` ## Heading{.highlight} →

Heading

``` Rendered ## Heading{.highlight} ### Inline (just part of a sentence) Writing `[text]{.className}` wraps it in a `` with a class/id. You can combine multiple classes/IDs (space-separated). Markdown → HTML ``` Let's try some [red text]{.red} and some [bold text with a background color]{.highlight .bold} in a sentence. ↓ Let's try some red text and some bold text with a background color in a sentence. ``` Rendered Let's try some [red text]{.red} and some [bold text with a background color]{.highlight .bold} in a sentence. Nesting is also supported. The inner `[...]{...}` is processed first, and the outer span wraps around it (three or more levels of nesting are possible). This is handy for embedding icons from an icon font, such as Material Symbols, inside a button-style span or badge. Note that the content of a `[...]{...}` cannot contain a bare `[` without a matching `{...}`, since nested brackets are interpreted as spans. Markdown → HTML ``` This is an [[important]{.red} notice]{.highlight}. ↓ This is an important notice. ``` Rendered This is an [[important]{.red} notice]{.highlight}. This is a mikanBox-specific extension, so it won't work in GitHub or other standard Markdown renderers. --- ## Mixing Markdown and HTML blocks The body is processed as Markdown by default, but any line starting with one of the following HTML tags is treated as raw HTML as-is (not converted by Markdown). html head body div section article aside header footer main nav form p h1–h6 ul ol li dl dt dd table thead tbody tr th td blockquote pre figure figcaption details summary dialog a span button select video audio script style link meta, ``, and so on. Both opening and closing tags (e.g. ``, ``) are covered. You don't need blank lines before or after them (adding them doesn't change the output). If there's a blank line before and after, and no HTML tags or Markdown symbols are present, the text is treated as a "paragraph" and wrapped in `

…

`. Line breaks inside a paragraph become `
` (not added immediately before/after an HTML tag). You can mix HTML tags inside a paragraph too. For complex layouts that Markdown+HTML mixing can't handle, turn on the **"Raw HTML" checkbox** on the page editor screen to fully disable Markdown processing and output the HTML as-is.
